name: (table)
description: metadata about extracellular electrodes

name: x
description: the x coordinate of the channel location

name: y
description: the y coordinate of the channel location

name: z
description: the z coordinate of the channel location

name: imp
description: the impedance of the channel

name: location
description: the location of channel within the subject e.g. brain region

name: filtering
description: description of hardware filtering

name: group
description: a reference to the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: group_name
description: the name of the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: site_id
description: The site number, in within-probe numbering, of the channel (in practice for this dataset this always starts at zero and counts up to 383 on each probe so is equivalent to the channel number - but if switches had been used, the site number could have been different than the channel number).

name: site_position
description: The x- and y-position of the site relative to the face of the probe (where the first column is across the face of the probe laterally and the second is the position along the length of the probe; the sites nearest the tip have second column=0).

name: ccf_ap
description: The AP position in Allen Institute's Common Coordinate Framework.

name: ccf_dv
description: The DV position in Allen Institute's Common Coordinate Framework.

name: ccf_lr
description: The LR position in Allen Institute's Common Coordinate Framework.

name: entry_point_rl
description: mediolateral position of probe entry point relative to midline (microns). Positive means right

name: entry_point_ap
description: anteroposterior position of probe entry point relative to bregma (microns). Positive means anterior

name: vertical_angle
description: vertical angle of probe (degrees). Zero means horizontal. Positive means pointing down

name: horizontal_angle
description: horizontal angle of probe (degrees), after vertical rotation. Zero means anterior. Positive means counterclockwise (i.e. left).

name: axial_angle
description: axial angle of probe (degrees). Zero means that without vertical and horizontal rotations, the probe contacts would be pointing up. Positive means "counterclockwise.

name: distance_advanced
description: How far the probe was moved forward from its entry point. (microns).

name: (table)
description: Autogenerated by NWBFile

name: peak_channel
description: The channel number of the location of the peak of the cluster's waveform.

name: waveform_duration
description: The trough-to-peak duration of the waveform on the peak channel.

name: phy_annotations
description: 0 = noise (these are already excluded and don't appear in this dataset at all); 1 = MUA (i.e. presumed to contain spikes from multiple neurons; these are not analyzed in any analyses in the paper); 2 = Good (manually labeled); 3 = Unsorted. In this dataset 'Good' was applied in a few but not all datasets to included neurons, so in general the neurons with _phy_annotation>=2 are the ones that should be included.

name: cluster_depths
description: The position of the center of mass of the template of the cluster, relative to the probe. The deepest channel on the probe is depth=0, and the most superficial is depth=3820. Units: µm

name: sampling_rate
description: Sampling rate, in Hz.

name: spike_times
description: the spike times for each unit

name: electrodes
description: the electrodes that each spike unit came from

name: electrode_group
description: the electrode group that each spike unit came from

name: waveform_mean
description: the spike waveform mean for each spike unit

name: spike_amps
description: The peak-to-trough amplitude, obtained from the template and template-scaling amplitude returned by Kilosort (not from the raw data).

name: spike_depths
description: The position of the center of mass of the spike on the probe, determined from the principal component features returned by Kilosort. The deepest channel on the probe is depth=0, and the most superficial is depth=3820.

name: (table)
description: Intervals of sufficient duration when nothing else is going on (no task or stimulus presentation

name: start_time
description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

name: stop_time
description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

name: (table)
description: experimental trials

name: start_time
description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

name: stop_time
description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

name: included
description: Importantly, while this variable gives inclusion criteria according to the definition of disengagement (see manuscript Methods), it does not give inclusion criteria based on the time of response, as used for most analyses in the paper.

name: go_cue
description: The 'goCue' is referred to as the 'auditory tone cue' in the manuscript.

name: visual_stimulus_time
description: Times are relative to the same time base as every other time in the dataset, not to the start of the trial.

name: visual_stimulus_left_contrast
description: Proportion contrast. A value of 0.5 means 50% contrast. 0 is a blank screen: no change to any pixel values on that side (completely undetectable).

name: visual_stimulus_right_contrast
description: Proportion contrast. A value of 0.5 means 50% contrast. 0 is a blank screen: no change to any pixel values on that side (completely undetectable).

name: response_time
description: Times are relative to the same time base as every other time in the dataset, not to the start of the trial.

name: response_choice
description: Enumerated type. The response registered at the end of the trial, which determines the feedback according to the contrast condition. Note that in a small percentage of cases (~4%, see manuscript Methods) the initial wheel turn was in the opposite direction. -1 for Right choice (i.e. correct when stimuli are on the right); +1 for left choice; 0 for Nogo choice.

name: feedback_time
description: Times are relative to the same time base as every other time in the dataset, not to the start of the trial.

name: feedback_type
description: Enumerated type. -1 for negative feedback (white noise burst); +1 for positive feedback (water reward delivery).

name: rep_num
description: Trials are repeated if they are "easy" trials (high contrast stimuli with large difference between the two sides, or the blank screen condition) and this keeps track of how many times the current trial's condition has been repeated.

name: lickPiezo
description: Voltage values from a thin-film piezo connected to the lick spout, so that values are proportional to deflection of the spout and licks can be detected as peaks of the signal.

name: wheel_position
description: The position reading of the rotary encoder attached to the rubber wheel that the mouse pushes left and right with his forelimbs.

name: (module)
description: behavior module

name: wheel_moves
description: Detected wheel movements.

name: lick_times
description: Extracted times of licks, from the lickPiezo signal.

name: face_motion_energy
description: Features extracted from the video of the frontal aspect of the subject, including the subject's face and forearms.

name: eye_area
description: Features extracted from the video of the right eye.

name: eye_xy_positions
description: Features extracted from the video of the right eye.
